repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个社区驱动的开发者学习路线图项目，提供前端、后端、DevOps、AI工程师、数据科学等30+技术方向的交互式可视化学习路径。用户可点击节点查看详细内容，涵盖从入门到进阶的完整技能体系，帮助开发者清晰规划职业发展和技术成长方向。
repos.summary_en: This community-driven project offers interactive visual learning roadmaps for developers across 30+ technical domains including frontend, backend, DevOps, AI engineering, and data science. Users can click nodes to access detailed content, covering complete skill paths from beginner to advanced levels, helping developers clearly plan career development and technical growth.

repos.description: Qlib is an AI-oriented Quant investment platform that aims to use AI tech to empower Quant Research, from exploring ideas to implementing productions. Qlib supports diverse ML modeling paradigms, including supervised learning, market dynamics modeling, and RL, and is now equipped with https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent to automate R&D process.
repos.summary_zh: Qlib是微软开源的AI驱动量化投资平台，旨在用AI技术赋能量化研究全流程。平台支持监督学习、强化学习等多种机器学习范式，并集成RD-Agent实现因子挖掘与模型优化的自动化研发。适用于从策略构思到生产部署的全场景，提供跨平台支持，助力量化投资智能化升级。
repos.summary_en: Qlib is Microsoft's open-source AI-powered quantitative investment platform designed to empower the entire quant research workflow with AI technology. The platform supports diverse ML paradigms including supervised learning, market dynamics modeling, and reinforcement learning. It integrates RD-Agent, an LLM-based autonomous framework that automates factor mining and model optimization. Suitable for scenarios ranging from strategy ideation to production deployment, Qlib offers cross-platform support and accelerates intelligent transformation in quantitative investing.

repos.summary_zh: Vibe-Trading 是港大开源的个人AI交易代理系统，通过单一命令赋予智能体完整交易能力。采用Python 3.11+与FastAPI后端、React 19前端，支持MCP协议实现模型交互。核心亮点包括Swarm集群容错恢复、影子账户模拟交易、Rich交互式CLI。提供API与MCP服务，支持实时任务协调与状态管理，为量化交易提供开箱即用的AI解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vibe-Trading is HKU's open-source personal AI trading agent system that empowers agents with comprehensive trading capabilities through a single command. Built with Python 3.11+ and FastAPI backend, React 19 frontend, it supports MCP for model context interaction. Key features include Swarm cluster fault tolerance recovery, shadow account simulation, Rich interactive CLI, and automated operations. It provides API and MCP services, enabling real-time task coordination and state management for quantitative trading with out-of-the-box AI solutions.

repos.description: A Programmer’s Guide to Longevity | Helping everyone live a longer, healthier, happier life. Available in 8 languages.
repos.summary_zh: 本指南专为程序员设计，基于全因死亡率（ACM）学术证据，提供量化延寿策略。核心通过优化饮食（如蔬果、坚果摄入降低27% ACM）、运动（挥拍运动降47% ACM）及生活习惯（7小时睡眠），目标降低66.67% ACM并增加20年预期寿命。亮点在于结构化输入-输出框架及争议数据处理，直击久坐职业健康痛点。
repos.summary_en: Tailored for programmers, this guide leverages all-cause mortality (ACM) research to deliver quantified longevity strategies. Key actions include dietary optimization (e.g., fruits/nuts reducing ACM by 27%), racket sports (47% ACM reduction), and sleep management (7-hour optimum), targeting 66.67% ACM decrease and ~20-year lifespan gain. Unique for its input-output framework and evidence-based controversy analysis, addressing sedentary occupational health risks.

repos.description: A vector index built on TurboQuant, written in Rust with Python bindings
repos.summary_zh: turbovec 是基于 Google TurboQuant 算法的 Rust 向量索引库，提供 Python 绑定。无需训练即可在线摄入向量，将 1000 万 float32 向量从 31GB 压缩至 4GB，搜索速度媲美或超越 FAISS。支持 SIMD 优化内核、搜索时内核过滤、稳定 ID 及 O(1) 删除，专为隐私敏感、低内存、低延迟的 RAG 场景设计，支持 LangChain 等框架无缝集成，实现完全本地化向量搜索。
repos.summary_en: turbovec is a Rust vector index with Python bindings built on Google's TurboQuant algorithm. It enables training-free online ingestion, compressing a 10M float32 vector corpus from 31GB to 4GB while matching or exceeding FAISS search speeds via SIMD kernels. Features include in-kernel filtering for hybrid retrieval, stable IDs with O(1) deletes, and persistence. Ideal for privacy-focused, memory-efficient, low-latency RAG, with drop-in integrations for LangChain, LlamaIndex, and others for fully local vector search.

repos.description: Build your autonomous hedge fund in minutes. AutoHedge harnesses the power of swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trade execution.
repos.summary_zh: AutoHedge 是一个基于群体智能的多代理AI系统，可自动化构建对冲基金。系统采用Director、Quant、Risk Manager、Execution四层代理架构，实现从市场分析、策略生成到风险控制和交易执行的全流程自主化。目前支持Solana链上全自动交易，采用风险优先设计，提供结构化输出和企业级日志，适用于机构级量化交易场景。
repos.summary_en: AutoHedge is an enterprise-grade autonomous hedge fund platform powered by swarm intelligence and multi-agent AI systems. It orchestrates specialized agents for market analysis, strategy generation, risk management, and trade execution in a risk-first pipeline. Currently supporting full autonomous trading on Solana, it features structured JSON outputs, comprehensive logging, and modular architecture for institutional-grade quantitative trading with minimal human intervention.

repos.description: 京东抢购自动下单助手，GUI 支持 Windows 和 macOS
repos.summary_zh: 京东小猪手是Python开发的跨平台自动抢购助手，核心功能包括7x24小时库存监听、自动下单及微信通知。支持扫码登录与预售定金模式，提供Windows/macOS图形界面，简化配置流程。采用SKU/AreaID精准定位商品与配送区域，适用于秒杀、缺货商品监控等场景，提升抢购成功率。
repos.summary_en: JdBuyer is a Python-based cross-platform automation assistant for JD.com flash sales. It provides 24/7 stock monitoring, automatic order placement, and WeChat notifications. The tool features QR code login, GUI support for Windows/macOS, and handles pre-sale deposits. Users configure SKU/AreaID for precise targeting, making it effective for seckill events and out-of-stock tracking, giving regular buyers equal opportunity against automated scalpers.

repos.description: QuantMind is an open source agent-native knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance.
repos.summary_zh: QuantMind是面向量化金融的智能知识提取与检索框架，将论文、新闻、报告等非结构化内容转化为语义知识图谱。采用两阶段架构：提取阶段通过多模态解析、领域特定LLM和智能代理实现结构化、标签化与去重；检索阶段支持嵌入向量、RAG、多跳推理等场景。适用于对冲基金、机构投资者快速探索因子策略与市场洞见，提升研究效率并挖掘Alpha。获NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop接受。
repos.summary_en: QuantMind is an intelligent knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance. It transforms unstructured content such as papers, news, reports, and SEC filings into a semantic knowledge graph. Built on a decoupled two-stage architecture, the extraction stage uses multi-modal parsing, domain-specific LLMs, tagging, and agentic workflows for structuring and deduplication; the retrieval stage enables embeddings, RAG, DeepResearch multi-hop reasoning, and knowledge-aware generation. Ideal for hedge funds and research teams to accelerate factor and risk model discovery. Accepted at NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop.

repos.description: 零知识证明入门教程。Comprehensive Zero-Knowledge Proofs Tutorial. #zk #WIP
repos.summary_zh: WTF-zk 为零知识证明入门教程，面向高中数学基础学习者。项目以 Python 实现核心算法，系统涵盖数论、抽象代数、椭圆曲线等数学基础，并逐步深入 ZK 证明理论。通过 Jupyter Notebook 交互式教学，结合经典密码学方案复现，为零知识证明领域提供低门槛、理论与实践结合的学习路径。
repos.summary_en: WTF-zk is a comprehensive Zero-Knowledge Proofs tutorial designed for learners with only high school mathematics background. The project uses Python to implement core cryptographic algorithms, systematically covering essential mathematical foundations including number theory, abstract algebra, ring fields, and elliptic curves. Through interactive Jupyter Notebook demonstrations and step-by-step reproduction of classic schemes like RSA and Diffie-Hellman, it creates an accessible, theory-practice integrated learning pathway into the ZK proofs domain.

repos.description: A taxonomy for open source cryptocurrency, blockchain, and decentralized ecosystems
repos.summary_zh: Electric Capital 推出的 Open Dev Data 是一个结构化的区块链与 Web3 开源生态分类法。它提供 CLI 工具链，支持按时间快照导出 JSONL 格式的仓库数据，并集成 DuckDB 实现本地高性能分析。通过交互式 SQL 界面，开发者可快速洞察比特币、以太坊等生态的子系统分布与项目演进，为生态研究提供精准数据基础。
repos.summary_en: Open Dev Data by Electric Capital is a structured taxonomy for blockchain and Web3 open-source ecosystems. It offers a CLI toolkit to export repository data in JSONL format with historical snapshots, integrates DuckDB for local high-performance analytics, and provides an interactive SQL interface. Developers can quickly analyze subsystem distributions and project evolution across ecosystems like Bitcoin and Ethereum, enabling precise ecosystem research.

repos.description: Official repository of my book "A Hands-On Guide to Fine-Tuning LLMs with PyTorch and Hugging Face"
repos.summary_zh: 这是一本使用PyTorch和Hugging Face微调大语言模型的实战指南。系统讲解量化、LoRA低秩适配、数据集格式化等稳定核心技术，涵盖模型加载、SFTTrainer微调到本地部署全流程。提供可直接运行的Google Colab notebooks，适合具备Transformer基础的中级开发者深入理解配置原理与底层实现。
repos.summary_en: A hands-on guide repository for fine-tuning Large Language Models with PyTorch and Hugging Face. Covers quantization, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and dataset formatting templates through practical Colab notebooks. Includes complete workflow from loading quantized models to supervised fine-tuning with SFTTrainer and local deployment. Targets intermediate practitioners, explaining configuration principles and stable concepts essential for adapting to evolving LLM technologies.

repos.description: Connector for decentralised post-quantum secure network - VeilNet
repos.summary_zh: VeilNet Conflux 是连接去中心化抗量子安全网络的节点软件，采用改进 WebRTC 栈实现点对点通信。核心特性包括基于污点（taint）的访问控制机制，节点需共享污点才能互联；支持 Terra 免费无区域 Realm 和 Conduit 互联网共享模式。通过优化 Exp3 路由算法和自动连接配对，提供低延迟、高吞吐的安全网络连接，适用于构建抗量子威胁的分布式通信基础设施。
repos.summary_en: VeilNet Conflux is a node connector for decentralized post-quantum secure networks, utilizing a modified WebRTC stack for P2P communication. Key features include taint-based access control requiring shared taints for node connectivity, free regionless Terra Realm, and Conduit mode for internet sharing. Optimized with the Exp3 routing algorithm and automatic connection pairing, it delivers low-latency, high-throughput secure networking, ideal for building quantum-resistant distributed communication infrastructure.

repos.description: For Investing for Programmers book published by Manning
repos.summary_zh: 本书专为程序员编写，系统讲解如何利用编程技能进行量化投资与算法交易。内容涵盖金融数据分析、交易策略开发、回测系统构建等实战主题，使用Python等工具将编程思维应用于投资决策。适合希望将技术优势转化为投资能力的开发者，提供可复用的代码示例与项目实践。
repos.summary_en: Specifically designed for programmers, this book systematically explains how to leverage coding skills for quantitative investing and algorithmic trading. It covers practical topics including financial data analysis, trading strategy development, and backtesting system construction, using tools like Python to apply programming thinking to investment decisions. Suitable for developers who want to transform their technical advantages into investment capabilities, it provides reusable code examples and project practices.
